section: Open base, wall and tall units, from 45 to 90 cm wide th. 2.2
family_note: JOINS family H.78 and declares no family key: height, ground and plinth come from the family, as the fillers of printed p.434 do.
extraction_note: 2026-09-28 (Andriy: cheap open shelving of small depth). Printed p.455 and p.456 taken whole except the base H.60 row of p.455 (BE0145 / BF0145 - no base family H.60 in the catalog; the H.60 prefix belongs to the top elements).

open_base_190.description: Open base unit, 2,2 cm thick - 1 fixed shelf

front_layout.note: AN OPEN UNIT HAS NO FRONT. 'none' is stated rather than left absent: Panel.effective_slabs defaults a missing layout to 'single' and would hang a door on an open box.

open_base_190.notes: Printed d.37,5 / d.64,5 = carcass 35 / 62 + the 2,2 door plane (printed p.450: 'The depth measurements are based on 2.2 cm thick doors'). depth_includes_front: the box is drawn from the door plane back, flush with the doored units beside it. WIDTH IS ORDERED, NOT CODED: the 0145 codes (printed p.455) cover 150-450 mm, the 0190 codes (printed p.456) 450-900 mm - the page titles. 450 is inside both ranges; which code Cesar means at exactly 450 is not printed. Finishes printed p.453-454: melamine band 1, Technomat 2, Fenix NTM 4, silk lacquer 5, gloss/structured 6, veneers 7-8, metallic, Fenix NTA; 2,2 thick in every one. Bands 3, 9 and 11 are '-' on every row.
open_base_190.wall_hung_note: NOT OFFERED: no 'Surch. for wall-hung version' line in the margin of printed p.455 or p.456 (110-dpi renders, 2026-09-28); the elevations draw feet.
